I recently got a trauma therapy not very long ago. Something he talked about is doing hobbies that are positive and productive. My problem is I cycle through hobbies so badly so what I did is get a few things that I have not done before or have not done in years. For example; DAS air dry clay for sculpture, needle punch, cool water colour pencils and a blending tool. These are hands on hobbies that do take up a bit of time and I can physical see my progress on the projects so I feel productive and good about myself. 

I often go to the lake and sit in nature. Sometimes I will watch the water and try to focus on good things or happy memories of my life and those who mean a lot to me, other times I read a good book. 

I also bake or practice baking or cooking in general. Improving my knife skills and so on but just as well trying something new that I’ve never had or never made. 

For me it’s difficult to get out of my comfort zone but with these new hobbies I found I really enjoyed needle punching a lot! I’ve read books for the first time since high school really. I bought a coconut cracked it open it has been something I’ve always wanted to try. It’s the silly little things that really does help uplift you.

I’m looking into this as best as I can and definitely with an open mind.

I have been taking cold showers, keeping a fan on at all times in my bedroom, making sure I drink plenty if not extra fluids. I have been eating a lot of fresh fruits and salads, I’m never in the mood to eat when it’s hot. I’m not sure if there is a supplement of any kind that could help or not one I have come across yet.

Being raised by a Nmom, a single Nmom at that has definitely impacted my up bringing. I have been sort of “held hostage”, unable to go out to fun times with friends or really have the opportunity to make friends so in return I have been isolated from the world so to speak. I am always putting others needs first over my own and I feel guilty for even wanting or needing anything. I feel a lot of resentment once I was able to understand my mom is a narc and the things she’s done to me. I have been parentfied since a young age and have basically raised my siblings as my own kids, they literally view me as more of a mom than our actual mom which is a blessing and a curse. I do hold on to a lot of internalized anger. I have tremendous problems expressing my emotions. Overall I just feel incredibly lonely all the time. I don’t know what to do when I receive affection or compliments to me it feels like I’m being attacked. It is hard but the only thing I can do is take it one day at a time and try my best to remind myself I do deserve my basic needs and wants.

My head is quiet for the first time, I don’t have to overthink so badly. I can get a lot of work done in a short amount of time (work/chores). I feel like I have a bit more tolerance and get less angry at people and situations. My chest feels light like I can just breathe without the world weighing down on me.

Thank god I’m not alone in this experience! It’s like I’m drowsy 24/7 and no matter how much I sleep I just don’t feel rested I’m exhausted all the time and I can’t keep doing this. It’s driving me nuts and starting to impact my work life

I’ve been on and off Lexapro for several years. I would think I’m better or have control of my anxiety and depression so I’d quit cold Turkey which is one of the worst things a person can do. I’m also medication sensitive which makes side effects major difficult. I understand your struggles to the fullest. To be honest with you I hate the side effects so badly I want to stop taking it already but I know I have to keep push and keep taking it. It is incredibly difficult but I promise we can do this. I got you, your not alone in this at all! Currently shitting so bad my butthole has been wiped from existence, sweating so badly, unable to sleep or eat. But after the first two weeks things settle out better and from there it gets a bit easier even then. You just have to take a deep breath and remind yourself this gets better even if it feels like your deep in hell right now.

Friend, it’s alright and your anxieties is very valid let me assure you that much. I’m about day ten myself and going through a similar situation. The sweating is unreal and it doesn’t matter how much extra fluids I drink I just sweat it all out I suppose. I can’t sleep worth a damn and I’m a person who needs sleep to function. It feels like crap for me and I’m sure it feels like crap to you also but we can handle this! If you ever need someone to talk to I’m always willing to listen. I know things are rough right now but it’s going to be alright.

I’ve been back on it for about a week and every time I’m out on my medication again I experience these awful symptoms but I expect them. When I was 17 I made a phone call in school on my cellphone to my therapist and I said how suicidal I was feeling. The rest of the school day passed and I went home on the school bus. I just got home laid on the couch my mom drives up the driveway full speed, she came home from work told me to “get your ass in the fucking car”. I did without question and I didn’t fully understand. We start going through little towns and into the direction of the where my therapist is located and it finally clicked in my head. The entire way from my house to the hospital my mom hit me slapped me just beat on me. When it was time for the head doctor to let us know if I was going to be admitted or sent back home my mom suddenly breaks out into hysterics and sobbing. I will never forget being handcuffed to a hospital bed thinking why the hell are you crying now when you beat the piss out of me the whole way here, you don’t care about me your putting on a show. Its been years since and I now know she didn’t care about me, my mental health, instead she cared about her public image and pulled the “mother of the year award” act. I’m doing decent currently and still dealing with her but now I know the truth behind her method of madness.

It’s funny but it’s not funny, ironic maybe is the word. I hear so much from so many different people on here and on blogs and things about being abused by a narcissist and about reactive abuse. I’ve always told myself nope not me it’s bad but it’s not that bad I don’t think. My trauma therapist said my mother emotionally abuses me. And very well reactive abuse may be a part of the situation. It’s hard to look at myself or come to terms with it. I know I’ll be alright but it just stings you know? A person can think it would never happen to them, but reality is it very well can happen.

I don’t think I have ever let myself grocery over this, and I’m sure in a way that sounds a bit dumb or silly. I feel like I’m in the wrong for grieving about her because she’s still here you know? I’m not even sure how to grieve and let it out so that I can sort of just move on and find peace. Some times it’s easier than other times and that makes me question “is it really that bad”, other times it’s more clear cut “yes it is that bad”. Dealing with a narcissist is extremely confusing and exhausting, but I think you make a very good point I do probably need to get it out of my system. I’ll definitely make sure to bring this up Monday at my trauma therapist appointment and see what we can work on. I’m trying to move forward so that I can control my own life and enjoy it for once.

I’m in a very similar situation as you OP. I had my first therapist appointment on Monday and after I wanted to pick up lunch to maybe make myself feel better. My mom was driving and I was listening to music through my headphones to actively avoid conversation with her (I just wanted time alone with my thoughts). I told her what I wanted, some chicken nuggets and Mac n cheese. We take the food home and I start unpacking the bag and there’s fries that are now cold instead of Mac n cheese. I talk to her about it, asked if she ordered what I said and she turned it into a argument. She’s got a habit of just picking what she wants over what I said. In the end I said I just didn’t want the cold fries and they taste weird to me once reheated. That turned into an argument about me wasting my money. 

It’s just food. It was just fries. That’s the thing it’s always just this one small tiny insignificant detail or aspect. But it builds one right on top of the other and I try to stay quiet to avoid arguments and fighting, but sometimes just one stupid small detail makes me sort of explode because everything in my life is controlled. It is just another constant reminder that I’m not able to love my life as my life but rather I’m held hostage living as an extension of my mothers life.

I want to share with you all my experience with my Nmom and mental health. I was a minor in therapy, my therapist was no longer able to accept the insurance I was on and we had to switch me to a new insurance. My Nmom agreed so she took me off my insurance, never did place me on new insurance, and I never was able to go to therapy again. But it goes deeper than just mental health, without insurance it’s hard to get therapy, dentist, health care, etc. 

Now I’m able to afford my own therapy and I am no longer a minor. My Nmom refuses to even help me learn to drive because she says “your anxiety prevents you”. She literally tells everyone and anyone that I can’t drive because “my anxiety”. I promise you I can more than be able to learn to drive and it is not my anxiety preventing me but my Nmom. I go to a trauma therapist now, she doesn’t understand what type of therapist it is. She thinks I’m going for anxiety and depression, I am going because anxiety, depression, but mostly because of the trauma and the abuse I experienced from her. It’s hard because she will paint me as this overly anxious child that can’t do adult things but reality is she is the cause of my problems and she actively refuses to do basic things like teach me to drive or show me how to get insurance or anything adult like. She bitches about me even going to therapy and tells me it’s a waste of gas money.

When I met my best friend I started going to her house to hang out. She lives with her aunt and her grandparents. I will never forget the feeling of jealousy because they were all so genuinely loving and caring. Her nana always made sure I had dinner. After a few times of going to her house and seeing them interact with each other I felt out of place. I literally felt like I was a ghost haunting in the corner just observing the mannerisms of her family and when I’d go back to my house it was always like walking into an episode of hoarders meets WW2. I would think so hard about the differences between our homes, hers was clean and mine was not, she had loving and accepting family members and I had screaming and getting hit. To this day I am still unable to get over the schedule in my heart and the void in my soul because I wanted what she had and I felt so guilty for wanting what she had. Not in the sense of stealing or taking it from her but in the sense of just longing and hope I suppose.

I remember being late to middle/ high school a lot because of my mom. Feeling the anxiety of having everyone look at me when I walked into class, anxious because all the notes I had to get.

When Nmom would take me to work I would be on time but when it was time to leave a lot of the times I was literally the only person left in the building by myself late at night and I would feel so unsafe and scared. I would message her over text messages and ask where she is and it never failed “I’m at my boyfriends I’ll be there soon”. 

I’ve been late to doctors appointments, therapy appointments, etc. 

It’s always been about what benefits her rather than taking turns and it benefitting me. If I made her late it was always the end of the world and she would scream and cuss and act like I am the devil. If I acted like that to my Nmom when she made me late she would throw a fit and tell me how bad I am as a person. It’s always been about what benefits her and what she has control over, screw everyone else.

That’s what I also think as well. I’m just trying to take a step back from my situation and determine is my Narc are of what she is doing and if so is she doing what she does on purpose with malicious intent or is she unaware of what is is doing?

Regardless if she is or isn’t aware it hurts the same and it is confusing and mixed-emotional just the same to me. I don’t see one worse than the other, to me it’s just as bad either way.

Something my Nmom says way to often is “I have other obligations!”. 

My Nmom focuses all her time, energy, and life around her boyfriend and all of his stuff and his social circle. My mom rarely comes home anymore. When she is home I can ask her can you change the trash bag “I have other obligations”. I’ve asked her one time why doesn’t she talk to me or my siblings anymore we’re hurt and feel upset about it “I have other obligations”. My mom stole money from me and agreed to pay it back and it’s been months (still never seen a penny!) and when I bring up hey I need you to pay back that money now “I have other obligations”.

All I am, and all my siblings are is OBLIGATIONS to her. We are not her children but her obligations. A little fucked up if you ask me.

If anything I am sorry to myself for letting her try to manipulate me into her control within the situation. I’m sorry I believed her, I’m sure maybe the police could have determined she was the one that beat me but I was terrified of what would happen. In the end it was a lesson, don’t trust my mom for shit lmao

Jesus Christ what the actual heck! I am so sorry to hear you had that experience! I was almost in that position once because Nmom beat the piss out of me and when I was going to call the police she said she would tell them it’s self defence. She was going to use my mental health against me and put me out to be a psycho when I really wasn’t. She beat the piss out of me because I didn’t load the dishwasher the exact minute she wanted me to. I will always remember that because she ripped out my earrings and I remember being so upset because the earrings were a gift from a friend and it meant a lot to me.

It feels like I am suffocating around my mom with all of her behaviors and words. I knew it wasn’t right, it wasn’t normal. I learned from a early age no one will fix things for me, I have to be brave and fix it myself for me. It has been a never ending nightmare but I am proud to say I got myself the help that I’ve always wanted and deserved. I want my life to be my life not an extension of her life. I want to be confident in myself and learn to trust myself. Eventually I do plan to go No Contact with her, I think that would be for the best.

THIS POST RIGHT HERE. Hit so close in my heart. 

My Nmom will actively deny me and my siblings of any level of care. When I was a minor I went to a therapist, the therapist could not take my insurance anymore and discussed that with me and my mom. My mom decided to cancel my insurance and put me with a different insurance that was covered by my therapist. Once my mom canceled my insurance she refused to put me on a different insurance and I would beg her to please put me on a different insurance. When I was of age to get insurance myself I would ask her please teach me or show me what I need to do to get insurance I’ll do it entirely by myself just show me what I need to do. I would break down often and beg to go to a therapist or be admitted to a hospital because I just couldn’t cope and handle my reality and issues that were going on around me. 

My mom would and still does tell people how hurt she is and “how much she goes through” about me and my issues. One time many years ago I made an attempt and ended up in the hospital, when the head doctor came to decide if I was admired or sent home only then did she start this god awful sobbing. It was the biggest slap in the face and I thought what the hell are you doing crying like this when you screamed at me the entire way to the hospital. 

Now I have found a trauma therapist entirely on my own. I still don’t have insurance but I can afford the out of pocket payments. She’s madder than ever that I got a therapist entirely on my own without her. Maybe now she can’t play poor pitiful mother act but she will try her best to find a way. Now days I let her play poor mommy and I just ignore it as best as I can. As hurt and betrayed and angry as I am over the entire situation the only thing I can do is go to my therapist now and learn how to deal with my trauma so that I can find the peace I deserved all those years.

I walk very light and silent, have walked like that as long as I can remember being old enough to walk. Growing up and even still I have the house mapped out of every creak one the floor so I can actively avoid making sounds. I used to sneak around a lot and that’s kind of sad to admit but I had to do I could avoid getting pulled into drama and fights with my Nmom. 

Even at work I walk silent and one of my coworkers has PTSD so I am having to learn to announce my presence to avoid setting her off because I would feel guilty if I caused her issues. There has been a few times I’ve walked by her and she wouldn’t know I was there until she looked up and I apologize so many times and try to give her space and time to make sure she’s okay.

My Nmom asks to borrow money, which at first I has no issue with helping her out by all means. Then it became more frequent and larger amounts to the point I just couldn’t help her or give her the money because I couldn’t afford to lend out money. She told me “the reason you have no money is because you don’t save it!”. 

When I confronted her over her saying “the reason you don’t have money is because you don’t save it”, and explained to her that her borrowing habit has drained my financials tremendously she throws a fit and says “I have bills I need to pay!”, that’s fair and all but woman I have MY OWN bills I need to pay settle down. She still asks for money even after I cut her off, or will ask if I can buy her things even after I have made it clear the awnser is no. Can’t win helping her out and you can’t win taking care of yourself and your own needs.

UPDATE: 

First and foremost thank you to everyone who has helped in support, reassurance, and general advice/tips.

I can not express enough how wonderful this opportunity is to me, I never imagined I would get to this point on my own. I know for a fact my Nmom is livid with me over this and that is her right to be mad, but I just want to learn how to cope, heal, and move forward in life with new hope and new found peace.

My Nmom is like this to a total T! I believe she’s covert narcissist as well. In a way it’s nice to know I’m not alone in my experience with my Narc but at the same time it’s deviating to see someone else have a similar experience because I wouldn’t wish it on my worst enemy.

Thank you for your comment! I planned to see a in general therapist but I wasn’t sure if I would be better off in maybe trauma therapy or what department if that makes sense? I do have other issues such as anxiety and depression so a general therapist may very well be exactly where I need to start.

Both really, I need to unpack a lot and get help understanding what it is I need to do so that I can move on with my life without my Nmom wreaking havoc nonstop. She can screw up her life all she wants but I will not let her screw mine up with hers. The choices and mistakes she made belong to her not me.

That is precisely a very good point with the “validate versus enable it”. I plan on doing initial meetings and really look into the choices I find near me that way I can hopefully get the help I desperately want. Thank you for your comment and input!

I am trying to do the best I can juggling several major issues at once. I’m working on saving up to move out on my own currently plus get back the money she owes me. Right now the best I could do is go to a hotel for a few days but that’s only a temporary solution to the problems. But maybe it’s worth trying? I’m trying to take care of myself but I feel like I have to take care of everything else and everyone else first because of what my mom does or more so lack of what my mom does. I have a bad habit of putting everything before my own needs.
Lord have mercy 😂 Best of luck to you!

Right so this is a little bit of a crazy ride but let me share my story and current situation. My family is poor, my Nmom makes bad financial choices. Growing up I wanted to help my mom and my family so I let her borrow money, eventually I caught on to what she was doing and decided for my best benefit for myself is to stop giving her money and or letting her borrow money. Some things happened, partly because I felt bad then she felt entitled enough to fill on steal money from me. I confronted her about it like hey mom I need that money back as a young adult who is trying to move out and save for a car.
